title: MAN 2023 TGX Low-Profile Custom Built polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar #17
description: MAN 2023 TGX low profile custom built hi-tensile polished aluminium FUPS compliant Bullbar with security door mesh that minimises damage to body. 76mm diameter high tensile aluminium pipe for maximum protection. Heavy duty steel backing plate with removable tow pin. Provision for Emergency Brake Assist (EBA). Low profile allows front cab panel to open to allow for daily checks. The bull bar can be built to customer required custom build.
